evidence_class: Static review of the frozen physical-emitter source and exact helper-extraction patch, plus read-only inspection of parent-executed compile and strict-lint receipts. The reviewer ran no compile, test, candidate, solver, or physical command.

findings.finding: The frozen failure outcome emits only kind, outer_error_class, own_error_code, a Debug-formatted typed_error string, accepted_capture_present, and adapter_materialized. It does not expose the typed failure payload and controller state as structured JSON.
findings.required_fix: For every error variant, emit the discriminant and its structured payload. Subproblem must preserve kind plus optimality reason/coordinate/radius/lambda, attempted work, sweeps, pivots, SVD calls, raw-Jacobian maximum, refinement metadata, canonical refusal work, and any budget-refusal operation/snapshot. Numerical and Own(IncompleteScope) must remain distinguishable without parsing Debug text. Emit the failure-side controller run counts and current/final coordinate evidence needed to prove no accepted/materialized update. Retain typed_error only as supplementary evidence.
findings.correctness_effect: A physical failure can currently be observed, but its exact typed cause and full-work accounting cannot be independently checked or compared. Debug formatting is not a stable structured contract and can hide omissions or force lossy parsing.

findings.finding: The frozen success outcome's capacity_predicates records only diagnosed_liquid_mass_kg_m2 <= liquid_capacity_kg_m2. The preserved acceptance assertion requires both diagnosed_liquid_mass_kg_m2 >= 0.0 and diagnosed_liquid_mass_kg_m2 <= liquid_capacity_kg_m2.
findings.required_fix: Emit the nonnegative predicate and the within-capacity predicate separately, or emit their exact conjunction. The already-emitted raw diagnosed-mass and capacity bits remain sufficient operands; duplicate numeric fields are unnecessary.
findings.correctness_effect: The JSON can report capacity_predicates=true for a negative diagnosed liquid mass even though the preserved test assertion would reject that result.

findings.finding: The structured CPU observation records tick and frequency values or concrete errors, but it does not name the two measurement sources.
findings.required_fix: Name /proc/self/stat fields 14 and 15 as the process CPU tick source and getconf CLK_TCK as the frequency source in the emitted record.
findings.correctness_effect: The parser is statically correct, but a consumer cannot establish source provenance from the JSON alone.

static_verification.detail: The original 60-iteration setup solve and accepted-coordinate perturbation occur before timing. CPU and wall-clock samples bracket exactly one m1_trust_region_physical_adapter_proposal_for_test call. The emitted observation is materialized before success expectation, so a failure still produces the JSON. No compatibility control consumes the physical endpoint invocation.

The control starts from the accepted original60 coordinates, applies coordinate 20 += 1e-4, records setup and entry bits plus requested/actual delta, requires actual delta > 1e-8 and < 1, resets captures/activity/work, preserves the prior budget, and emits the complete protected input Debug representation.

After rsplit_once(')'), /proc/self/stat tail indices 11 and 12 are fields 14 utime and 15 stime. Both parse as u64 and use checked_add. getconf CLK_TCK checks command status, UTF-8, u64 parsing, and nonzero frequency. File, parsing, overflow, and command errors are propagated as concrete observation errors; absence is not mislabeled as a zero sample.

The record contains schema/method/control, protected input, setup and perturbed bits, perturbation values, wall and CPU observations, prior/solve/restored budgets, adapter counts and current coordinates, predictor/final runtime counts and dimensions, all controller accounting records, the overlap statement, face capture, phase events, accepted-capture state, and outcome.

m1_physical_work_json emits stage1 calls, SVD calls, pivots, sweeps, refinement scalar and guard charges, attempted and denied entries, first-residual, second-dot2, factor-application, coordinate-update, whole-KKT, and upward-enclosure operations and guards. m1_physical_budget_json emits attempted and entered evaluations plus core, raw-Jacobian, hydraulic, factorization, and materialization counts. The failure branch does not yet attach this structured evidence and remains blocked by the high finding.

static_verification.area: success and ordinary accepted update custody
static_verification.detail: The success record emits accepted coordinates, residual bits, binding status, all reservoir operands, Jacobian absence, materialization, captured input/coordinates/equality, controller run counts/coordinates/refusal state, and the common entry/final coordinate evidence. Together with the preserved assertions, accepted/final/entry bits and run counts are sufficient to reconstruct ordinary accepted-update custody; no duplicate fields are required.

static_verification.area: independent reservoir closure operands and arithmetic
static_verification.detail: Each reservoir record emits raw mass and enthalpy operands and diagnosed-capacity values as f64 bits. It independently reconstructs mass as ending - beginning - dt*(incident - vapor - drainage), and enthalpy as ending - beginning - dt*(non_vapor + incident*incident_enthalpy - vapor*(2501000 + 1849*(temperature - 273.15)) - drainage*4218*(temperature - 273.15)). It emits reconstructed bits, delta from the published value, both tolerances, and match/closure booleans. Operation order matches the preserved independent assertion helper.

assert_ordinary_update_success preserves the prior 63-line assertion tail: independent reservoir reconstruction, capacity and binding assertions, accepted-capture bit equalities, Jacobian absence, adapter input/trial custody, proposals=2, accepted=1, installed=1, materialization=1, final/materialized/captured equality, final differing from perturbation, no terminal refusal, and exact adapter/runtime/work counts.

The ac2852 change moves the unchanged literal success/failure match into a 56-line helper and replaces the inline match with one call. The only reference adjustment is input == *protected_input because the helper receives &M1CoupledColumnInput. Branch selection, expressions, field names, values, and evaluation order are unchanged. The extraction neither fixes nor worsens the three content findings above.
